Calcalou is a general wellness and food-logging tool. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition. Calorie and protein figures, targets, calculations, streaks and suggestions are general estimates, not personal medical, nutritional or dietetic advice.

Talk to a qualified health professional before you change your diet, start an exercise or weight programme, or if you are pregnant, have a medical condition or an eating disorder, or are under 18. Never ignore or delay professional advice because of something in Calcalou.
AI and food data are estimates

AI photo scans and food, barcode and nutrition data are approximate. Portions, oils, sauces and mixed dishes are especially hard to judge, and product data from third parties can be incomplete or wrong. A missing value is not zero.

Check labels and weighed amounts when accuracy matters, and review and edit every result before you save it. We do not guarantee that any estimate or data is accurate, complete or suitable for your purpose. You decide what to log and what to do with it.
